lines.text: Pioneers of Peri Peri chicken in Antigua

notes: Black roadside board in front of the restaurant on Dockyard Drive, English Harbour (camera 17.0122, -61.7686); a support post crosses the S of FLATTIES. 'GRILL' is in a flame-style font between two spatula icons. The yellow 'Carib REAL CARIBBEAN BEER' logo at the right end is advertising, not part of the label. Distractors: a second identical board at far right, 'JACKEE'S' sign on the white building, menu chalkboards and a 'Welcome to Jackee's...' easel. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Antigua and Barbuda, English Harbour (13), street scene with restaurants.jpg

author: CROIX
attribution: Photo: CROIX, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A_mosque_in_Antigua_and_Barbuda.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging white sign on a metal frame at the gate of a mosque in St. John's (camera 17.1132, -61.8292), seen from a distance and slightly from below; red arrow under 'Masjid' points left. At left is a decorative Arabic calligraphy logo (محمد, Muhammad) with tiny honorific text; it is not transcribed. Parked cars behind (number plates incidental and small). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:A mosque in Antigua and Barbuda.jpg
source_categories: Religious buildings in St. John's, Antigua and Barbuda

author: CROIX
attribution: Photo: CROIX, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:John_Hughes_welcome_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Weathered concrete village welcome sign, Saint Mary Parish (camera 17.0508, -61.8084). Blue stencilled 'WELCOME TO' (arched) / 'JOHN HUGHES' / 'COMMUNITY', then four red-brown locality names in two columns, each preceded by a dot (left: FOLLY, SAWCOLTS; right: BISHOP, WALLINGS), listed row by row. Bottom line '(DONATED BY F.S.CONSTRUCTION)' is faded and stained (the T of CONSTRUCTION is worn) and is not transcribed. Mould and rust streaks over the paint. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Saint Mary Parish, Antigua and Barbuda

author: CROIX
attribution: Photo: CROIX, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Road_sign_in_Antigua_and_Barbuda_2020s_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green US-style street blade on a rusty perforated post in Codrington, Barbuda (camera 17.6372, -61.8265). The post hides the 'R' and most of the 'T' of AIRPORT (only a sliver of the T shows), so the legible text is 'AIRPO' + 'RD.'; the sign reads Airport Rd. Distractor: the faded cross blade above, 'EAST / AIRPORT LN.' (first letters worn off). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Road sign in Antigua and Barbuda 2020s 01.jpg
source_categories: Road signs in Antigua and Barbuda
